audit_contract_revision.independent_validator_stop_point: The validator rejected the sealed camera_mask digest before reconstructing any v139 direction, candidate, metric or scientific decision.
audit_contract_revision.defect: The v139.0 protocol copied one hexadecimal character incorrectly in camera_mask_sha256. The formal runner obtained and verified the actual array through the unchanged v131 parent protocol, but the v139 protocol seal itself was invalid.
audit_contract_revision.repair: Replace only camera_mask_sha256 with the actual parent-bound digest, update executable source hashes and require complete formal and independent reruns.
audit_contract_revision.claim_boundary: The v139.0 output is invalid audit evidence and none of its numeric values may be used for selection, reporting or publication.

scientific_question: Can a deployment-visible, depth-resolved three-dimensional consensus/disagreement representation repair every remaining v138 observation-only failure while preserving the same 2A+2A^T online shell?

advisor_alignment.direction: Build a controlled multi-camera virtual BOS data set from reaction-flow CFD before one-time migration to new laboratory data.
advisor_alignment.camera_stress: The frozen roster contains 5, 7, 9 and 12 active cameras, camera order invariance, observation noise, extrinsic error, intrinsic error and combined perturbations.
advisor_alignment.future_real_data: Laboratory displacement images, calibration, masks and repeated-measurement noise are not available and remain outside v139.

prior_result.interpretation: v138 transports signed residuals through three pointwise target-ray anchors and peer reprojection. It does not retain a volumetric depth profile or explicitly separate coherent peer consensus from cross-camera disagreement. v139 changes only that physical representation.

data_contract.role: post-open fit-only depth-resolved representation capacity diagnostic
data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the complete v138 ray-overlap epipolar basis, retained as the first 56 directions per active camera.
representation_contract.visible_inputs: The active-camera zero-start CGLS K1 detector residual, predicted correction dual and each active camera's 18-value reported geometry token.
representation_contract.base_focal_length: Use the known reported scenario base focal length; each current focal length remains pose-token entry 10.
representation_contract.target_ray_domain: Clip every reported detector-pixel ray to the closed normalized reconstruction cube [-1,1]^3.
representation_contract.ray_sample_nodes: Midpoints t_j=-1+(2j+1)/12 for j=0,...,11 on each clipped ray segment.
representation_contract.residual_lift: Lift each camera's two signed detector residual components into world coordinates using that detector pixel's exact reported transverse ray basis.
representation_contract.volume_splat: Trilinearly splat the lifted residual vector at all 12 ray samples into a separate fixed coarse volume for each active camera, then divide each voxel vector by its accumulated interpolation weight.
representation_contract.leave_one_out_consensus: For each target camera and voxel, average only valid peer-camera vectors. Peer aggregation is unweighted and symmetric in the active peer set; zero peers map to zero.
representation_contract.agreement: Clip the norm of peer mean divided by peer mean vector norm to [0,1].
representation_contract.disagreement: Clip peer RMS vector scatter divided by peer mean vector norm to [0,2].
representation_contract.visibility: Peer valid-camera count divided by active-camera count minus one.
representation_contract.target_readout: Trilinearly sample target-specific peer volumes along the target's same 12 ray points and project consensus vectors onto its exact reported transverse basis.
representation_contract.odd_depth_moment: Consensus branch uses P1(t)=t weighted by visibility times agreement, normalized by the sum of abs(P1) times that weight.
representation_contract.even_depth_moment: Disagreement branch uses P2(t)=(3t^2-1)/2 weighted by visibility times disagreement, normalized by the sum of abs(P2) times that weight.
representation_contract.zero_denominator: A branch with denominator at most 1e-30 returns zero.
representation_contract.phase: For each target camera/component and each branch use tanh(depth_moment/RMS); RMS at most 1e-30 maps to zero.
representation_contract.new_directions: Multiply each v133 per-camera/component LL/LH/HL/HH direction once by the odd consensus phase and once by the even disagreement phase.
representation_contract.direction_order: All v138 parent directions, then eight odd-consensus directions per camera, then eight even-disagreement directions per camera.
representation_contract.nested_basis_counts: The full basis has 360, 504, 648 and 864 directions for 5, 7, 9 and 12 cameras.
representation_contract.strict_containment: The first 56 directions per active camera are exactly v138; zero new coefficients reproduce every v138 candidate.
representation_contract.camera_permutation_equivariance: Every camera uses the same splat, leave-one-out set reduction and readout. Permuting cameras permutes outputs and directions without changing the represented set, subject only to declared floating summation tolerance.
representation_contract.boundary_and_tie_break: Ray-cube coordinates tolerate 2e-12 before clipping; trilinear corners are ordered low-z/low-y/low-x first; equal candidates use frozen roster order.
representation_contract.deployment_boundary: Depth-volume generation is deployment-visible. Truth-aware coefficients and candidate selection are capacity-only and are not deployable estimators.

staged_evaluation.cheap_control_scope: Run deployment-visible per-camera/component joint ridge LS over all 36 directions in that group on all 3700 cells.
staged_evaluation.parent_retention: Retain independently validated v138 candidates for the 3397 already-passing cells.
staged_evaluation.oracle_scope: Run the seven-candidate truth-aware roster only on the frozen 303 v138 failure indices.
staged_evaluation.stratified_readout: Report remaining failures by camera count, trajectory and clean/noise/pose/intrinsic/combined factor.
staged_evaluation.scientific_boundary: The selected result is a truth-aware nested-span capacity upper bound, not a deployable coefficient predictor.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared teacher projected-lift error.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher projected-lift error with zero field weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of the same equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize coefficients to unit RMS and orient toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer all-four-metric feasibility by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise prefer physical feasibility and minimum observation; otherwise physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, metrics and selector use already-opened fit truth only to measure capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible depth-resolved residual joint ridge LS
cheap_control.definition: For each camera/component fit its 36 detector-space directions to the visible K1 residual with a fixed ridge, concatenate, normalize to unit RMS and use the unchanged observable line search.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact A_g^T lift and one exact A_g projection
call_accounting.depth_volume_generation_cost: Twelve fixed ray samples, trilinear camera-volume splat, leave-one-camera-out reductions, trilinear target readout and two detector phase maps; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.cheap_control_coefficient_cost: Detector-space 36x36 group solves only; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware batched lifts, seven solves and scoring are excluded from deployment cost claims.

decision_rule.cheap_control_pass_action: If the cheap control passes all cells and trajectories, attribute the result to the deterministic control.
decision_rule.oracle_pass_action: Only 3700/3700 plus all five trajectory tails, while the cheap control fails, authorizes a separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.
decision_rule.oracle_fail_action: Close this exact depth-resolved P1/P2 consensus-disagreement representation. Do not enlarge CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet; use independently validated failure strata to select a physically different next hypothesis.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Failure does not prove all volumetric multiview representations impossible; success does not prove prediction, speed, external generalization, curved-ray validity or real-BOST validity.
